Team — quick technical update from triage (brief):
- Timeline: issue surfaced ~07:50; correlated with a canary change that adjusted batch routing thresholds deployed at 07:31 (commit f3a9c2).
- Symptoms: uneven request batching causing KV cache pressure on a subset of inference shards; increased GC/serialization latency leading to timeouts and 5xx.
- Observed: ~60% of requests now hit cold paths; tail latency increased primarily on sequences >512 tokens.

Immediate recommended action:
1) Revert the routing change to last known-good (target: rollback in 30–45 min). Expected result: queue smoothing, tail latency back to baseline. Possible side-effect: transient increase in client 429s during rollback window.
2) If rollback isn't feasible quickly, scale out the affected shard pool by +30% as a short-term mitigation (will cost ~1.2x until stabilized).

Attachments: runbook-incident-rev2.pdf (see section 4 for rollback steps)

Requesting approval to proceed with rollback. Marissa / Soojin, please OK for customer-facing rollback (we'll publish steps and ETA).

Rishi
Engineering Lead, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
